message.content:
**Visual Diff: Original (Image 1) vs. Clone (Image 2)**

**(1) Top Bar (Logo, Pills, Links, Right-side items)**
*   **Primary Action Pill:** Image 1 has a dark, semi-transparent "Subscribe" pill. Image 2 has a bright gradient "7-Day Trial" pill (pink-to-blue).
*   **"Add On" Link:** In Image 1, "Add On" is followed by a small orange circle icon with a white play/arrow inside. In Image 2, the text is just "Add On" with no accompanying icon.
*   **Logo Icon:** The Hyper3D logo icon in Image 1 is solid white. In Image 2, it appears slightly lighter or has a subtle outline/glow effect.

**(2) Subnav (Avatar / 3D / Video)**
*   **Video Dropdown:** The "Video" tab in Image 1 has a small red dot next to it and a hamburger menu icon (three lines). In Image 2, it only has a standard downward-pointing chevron (v) and no red dot.
*   **Active State:** Both show "3D" as the active tab with a darker background. This section matches well structurally, but the icons differ.

**(3) Hero Area (Wordmark, Tabs, Quotes)**
*   **Version Tags:** Underneath the main "Rodin" wordmark, Image 1 only displays "Gen-2.5 Agent-Ready •". Image 2 displays *two* tags side-by-side: "Gen-1.5 V1.2" (greyed out/inactive) and "Gen-2.5 Agent-Ready •" (active).
*   **Background Blur/Glow:** The central background glow behind the "Rodin" text in Image 1 is softer and more diffused. In Image 2, the glow is noticeably sharper, more concentrated, and has a slightly more purple/magenta tint.

**(4) Input Card Cluster (Mode rail, card, upload, prompt, pill, tools rail)**
*   **Left Rail Icons:**
    *   **WorldGen:** Image 1 uses a globe icon labeled "Worldcoen". Image 2 uses a globe icon labeled "WorldGen".
    *   **Image to 3D:** The icon in Image 1 looks like a framed picture. In Image 2, it's a simpler square-with-mountain icon.
*   **Right Tools Rail (Vertical icons):** 
    *   **Top Icon (Eraser):** In Image 1, this is an eraser/wand icon with a small orange notification badge containing the number "4". In Image 2, it's a similar icon but the badge contains a red dot (or "1", it's smaller/different).
    *   **Bottom Icon:** The bottom-most icon on the right rail in Image 1 looks like stacked layers or a box. In Image 2, it looks like three horizontal lines (layers/menu).
*   **Card Styling:** The main "Image to 3D" card in Image 1 has a very dark, near-black background. In Image 2, the card background is visibly lighter (a lighter shade of grey/purple).

**(5) GENERATE Capsule Area**
*   **Layout & Surroundings:**
    *   **Lock Icon:** In Image 1, there is a lock icon (padlock) to the left of the GENERATE button. This icon is completely missing in Image 2.
    *   **Right-side Controls:** To the right of the GENERATE button, Image 1 has a "x1" chip with arrows and a link/share icon. Image 2 moves the "High" dropdown here (with an up-arrow), places the "x1" chip below it, and adds a "5 min" timer chip and a "Sign in to start" button.
    *   **Button Text Color:** The "GENERATE" text in Image 1 is white. In Image 2, the text is a darker shade (dark grey/purple), providing less contrast against the button's light gradient background.

**(6) Controls Row Chips**
*   **Content & Order:** This row is drastically different.
    *   **Image 1 (Left to Right):** Eye icon ("OFF"), Model selector ("< Gen-2. >"), Quality/Style icon ("High" with diamond).
    *   **Image 2 (Left to Right):** Lightning bolt ("OFF"), Text label ("Agentic Mode"), Model selector ("< Gen-2.5 Agent-Ready >"), Quality ("High" with diamond), Timer ("5 min"), CTA ("Sign in to start").
*   **Model Chip Text:** Image 1 says "Gen-2.5". Image 2 says "Gen-2.5 Agent-Ready".

**(7) Colors/Atmosphere/Lighting**
*   **Overall Contrast:** Image 1 has deeper blacks and higher contrast. Image 2 is generally brighter, with lifted blacks (the background isn't as dark).
*   **Cookie Banner Buttons:** 
    *   "Accept all": Image 1 is a deep, vibrant purple/blue. Image 2 is a lighter, more pastel lavender/purple.
    *   "Preferences": Image 1 is white with a thin border. Image 2 is also white but appears to have a slightly different border weight or shadow.
*   **Bottom Section (Asset/Explore):** 
    *   Image 1 shows empty space below the tabs.
    *   Image 2 populates this area with actual content cards (thumbnails of 3D models) and a search bar ("Filter") on the right. It also adds a floating "N" profile icon in the bottom left corner.

**Overall Similarity Score: 6/10**
*(The clone captures the general layout and "vibe" of the hero section perfectly, but fails significantly on specific UI states, text content, auxiliary buttons, and the populated bottom section.)*
